summary: Today presents a mixed news environment driven by major retail real estate consolidations and corporate governance litigation. Primary drivers include Nexus Select Trust's Rs 355-crore mall acquisition, Shalimar Paints' Rs 19,839-crore merger, and Reliance's 1,600-satellite network plans.

bullets.text: Nexus Select Trust acquired Kolkata's Diamond Plaza Mall for Rs 355 crore, housing major retail tenants including Reliance Digital, Pantaloons, and Max.
Shalimar Paints approved a Rs 19,839-crore merger with promoter Infra.Market to create a single consolidated entity listed on BSE and NSE.
Reliance plans to construct a 1,600-satellite network in India to directly compete with Elon Musk's Starlink satellite broadband service.
Meta agreed to pause issuing Class C shares during pre-trial and trial proceedings in a Delaware Court of Chancery shareholder lawsuit.
Tamil Nadu appealed to the Supreme Court against a Madras High Court order directing the removal of a Periyar statue from temple land.
